description.value: The Villa Motel is a 30-unit motel perched beside Nelson's iconic Big Orange Bridge with direct views of Kootenay Lake and the surrounding mountains. Eight room types — including full kitchenette suites — make it a practical base for longer stays in the Kootenay region. Downtown Nelson's Baker Street is a five-minute drive away, and Lakeside Park with its beach is a short walk across the bridge.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information. Key evidence: the /services page explicitly lists 'Private guest coin-op laundry' and the front page lists 'Free high-speed wireless internet,' corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying area, tools, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site. The privacy page title and policy text reference 'Breakfast at Monaco' and 'www.monaco.ph,' indicating a template was reused from an unrelated business — flagged as a concern but does not affect the listing's validity.
concerns: Privacy policy page title reads 'Privacy & Cookies Policy | Breakfast at Monaco' and the policy body references 'www.monaco.ph' — a template copied from an unrelated business. No impact on listing validity.
Website shows two different postal codes: V1L 6H8 in the page header/banner and V1L 6M6 in the footer contact block. Address field uses the header value (V1L 6H8).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active motel with a functioning website and confirmed contact details; a straightforward inclusion for touring cyclists seeking accommodation in Nelson.

Laundry.detail: Private guest coin-op laundry listed on the Groups & Corporate page
